messages:
alyssa: Quick note from Meridian onboarding healthcheck 1: p95 drifted from 120ms to 230ms on peak weekdays, and Customer Success flagged renewal concern if latency keeps trending up :confused:
sam: Do we have traces? compute vs queue?
diego: Mostly queueing during morning surge and some KV-cache churn on long-lived sessions. They're on a 30B fp16 endpoint with no quant.
alyssa: Proposal: canary an int8 build + add a compact 7B fallback for non-critical routes. Start small to avoid quality surprises.
sam: Agree. Canary split: 4% to 30b-int8 on dedicated-pool, 6% to 7b-compact hosted fallback. Monitor regen fidelity and cost delta.
diego: Ops notes: need attention-kernel tune for seq_len=1800, enable KV-prefetch on canary nodes, and pre-warm caches. Set per-route timeout 2.4s, failover after 1 retry.
alyssa: Can you draft the eval set and a short A/B script we can share with Meridian? CS wants token-cost delta + fidelity metrics for their renewal pack.
diego: Drafted snippet:
```json
{"canary": {"percent": 4}, "models": [{"name": "meridian-30b-int8","route": "dedicated-usw"}, {"name": "meridian-7b-compact","route": "hosted-fallback"}]}
```
sam: Ballpark cost impact?
diego: int8 ~30-40% token cost reduction vs fp16. 7B ~65-75% on fallback traffic. Latency: int8 compute may add ~10-20ms for short sequences but overall tail improves due to reduced queuing.
alyssa: I'll assemble the enablement playbook, include steps for logging prompt_id+eval_id to auto-flag regressions. Schedule a 20m customer handoff next Tue.
ops-bot: Reminder: create ticket CS-9010 for canary rollout and link ML-EVAL-710.
alyssa: Thanks team 1 tagging @sam @diego. Diego, please drop the eval artifacts and a quick checklist by EOD so we can propose the canary window Thu 7-9am PT.
diego: Will do, posting checklist shortly.
alyssa: This plan should give Meridian a clear route to lower unit cost and stabilize latency before renewal. :thumbsup:
